(3) Kadur District, Tulu upright Males read as 18 (bold, last digit looks like 8); row total 4,913 and State-excl. Tulu total 33 both imply 13 - kept as read. (4) Bangalore District shows italic Tulu Males 1 with no upright figure, while Kolar District shows upright Tulu Males 1 with no italic figure; State totals (33 upright / 11 italic) are consistent with these as printed.
